purpose: Local rule, feature and visual research
price_basis: one homogeneous source and raw/split basis per window; live split append requires matching historical overlap
membership_policy: confirmed + probable by default; unknown preserved, explicit sensitivity only
identity_policy: dated ID/ticker intervals; no issuer/predecessor/successor splice; known conflicts quarantined
split_policy: raw effective<=T factors once; split series never double-adjusted; unresolved jumps quarantined
missing_policy: all requested market sessions required; no forward fill or synthetic prices
quarantine_policy: only complete safe windows; later clean history can recover
delisted_policy: historical intervals retained independent of current survival
provenance_policy: row source hashes and ordered window hash; frozen manifests preserved
future_policy: bars/benchmarks/input metadata<=decision; labels never enter input; no Test rebranding
train_validation_test_policy: entire input contained in unchanged frozen signal split
fresh_oos_policy: decision>=2026-09-29; pre-F lookback allowed; input<=decision; pre-F model and parameter freeze mandatory for evaluation
fresh_oos_status: data preparation is allowed without model freeze; evaluation is unavailable until a verifiable pre-F freeze exists
tensor_policy: five OHLCV channels; price divided by first close, volume by within-window maximum; metadata excluded
determinism_policy: same identity/source/date/length/contract gives identical numeric input and SVG

research_relevant_disappeared.scope: Broad historically dated research qualification, not Strategy 2 or a runtime survival filter. Unpriced potential episodes remain eligibility-unknown.
